prompt:
The damage has grown worse, still in the same clean chunky toy style. Exactly these: one big jagged bite missing from the top of the gatehouse battlements, one of the two royal blue pyramid roofs gone clean off, one half of the long hall roof caved in as a simple angled break, the chimney snapped to a stump, and one row of large blocky rubble pieces along the foot of the walls. Everything else exactly as it is.

Same building, exactly the same camera angle, framing and plain light grey background, same art style and colours. Damage is big simple shapes with clean sharp edges. No fine gravel, no scattered small stones, no cracks, no dirt. No fire, no smoke, no people. Royal blue stays only on the parts that still stand. The building must look strictly worse than before: nothing repaired, nothing cleaner.
